target_pattern: Use the personal a before direct-object people and pets, omit it with inanimate direct objects, apply specificity rules with buscar/necesitar/contratar/encontrar, and avoid personal a with tener in normal possession meaning.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Skipping a before people because English has no equivalent marker.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish marks many direct-object people and pets with personal a, but not things, and not normally with tener.
target_pattern_formula: a alguien / a nadie usually takes personal a
natural_examples: Veo a Marta en la entrada.
Buscamos un tecnico para el turno de noche.
Necesitamos a los tecnicos que conocen este sistema.
Tengo dos hijas y un perro.
No conozco a nadie en esa empresa.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Veo a Juan. -> change object to inanimate plural (las casas).
Base: Conozco a Maria. -> make it negative.
Base: Ayudamos a nuestro vecino. -> change to singular subject yo.
Base: Buscamos un profesor. -> make the professor specific (que conocemos).
Base: Necesitan empleados. -> make employees specific (que conocen el sistema).
Base: Tengo dos hijos. -> change verb to conocer and keep meaning as close as possible.
Base: Llamo a mi hermana. -> change tense to preterite yo.
Base: Visitan a sus abuelos. -> make it a yes/no question with ustedes.
Base: Respetamos a nuestros maestros. -> change to ellos.
Base: Veo a mi perro. -> change pet to non-pet animal plural (delfines).
Base: No conozco a nadie aqui. -> change to affirmative with alguien.
Base: Contratamos a la ingeniera que ya conociamos. -> make object non-specific.
Base: Buscas a tu jefe. -> make it progressive (estar + gerundio) with tu.
Base: Ayudan a su cliente. -> make it negative and plural object (clientes).
Base: Encuentro a Carlos en la recepcion. -> change person object to object thing (el informe).

prompts: I see Sofia. (Veo a Sofia. vs Veo Sofia.)

We are looking for the mechanic who fixed our car. (Buscamos al mecanico que arreglo nuestro coche. vs Buscamos el mecanico que arreglo nuestro coche.)
They need workers, non-specific. (Necesitan trabajadores. vs Necesitan a trabajadores.)
They need the workers from last week. (Necesitan a los trabajadores de la semana pasada. vs Necesitan los trabajadores de la semana pasada.)
I have three children. (Tengo tres hijos. vs Tengo a tres hijos.)
I know no one here. (No conozco a nadie aqui. vs No conozco nadie aqui.)
We help our neighbor. (Ayudamos a nuestro vecino. vs Ayudamos nuestro vecino.)
She invited her sister to the event. (Invito a su hermana al evento. vs Invito su hermana al evento.)

common_errors.why_it_happens: English transfer omits marker before person objects.
Overgeneralizing personal a to all direct objects.

common_errors.mistake: Buscamos a un profesor. used automatically for any search
common_errors.why_it_happens: Assuming every human object always needs a.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Buscamos un profesor. for non-specific; Buscamos a un profesor que conocemos. for specific.

common_errors.mistake: Necesitamos los empleados que conocen el sistema.
common_errors.why_it_happens: Missing a with specific known people.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Necesitamos a los empleados que conocen el sistema.

common_errors.mistake: Conozco a las casas de ese barrio.
common_errors.why_it_happens: Confusing animate and inanimate object rules.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Conozco las casas de ese barrio.

common_errors.mistake: Treating every a in a sentence as personal a
common_errors.why_it_happens: Spanish also uses a for infinitive chains and destinations.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Analyze each role: Voy a invitar a mi hermano a la fiesta.
